name: Boy Who Fell From The Window
overview: The account of Eutychus, the young man who fell from a third-story window during Paul's extended preaching, highlights the power of God's life-giving presence even in seemingly hopeless situations. As the disciples gathered on the first day of the week, Paul’s message extended late into the night, during which Eutychus fell asleep and tragically plunged from the window, apparently dead. Yet Paul’s immediate embrace and assurance that his life remained in him reveals a profound truth about Christ’s sustaining power over death and the hope found in the gospel.
